parakeet: When I was deconverting as a believer, one absolute fact began to bother me. That God never wrote a book. This bothered me. That I if I was supposed to believe that this was the word of God, then why didn't God write it? Why wouldn't he why wouldn't he have written it after Adam and Eve failed? Why wouldn't he have written it after he had to destroy the whole earth? Why would he have only given Moses Ten Commandments if his desire was to have a whole Bible? And then even Jesus lived for 33 years, allegedly. Why didn't he write a book in the 33 years that that he was here? And then even further, why doesn't the Bible mention a book being written? Why don't either the prophets mention a book being written? So there you go. God never wrote a Bible, Jesus never wrote a Bible, and the Bible doesn't even talk about a Bible. So it just makes no sense.
